From 19:41:20 on, catalog-db and search-api queries fail with 'column currency_code does not exist', and search-api returns 500s that web-bff passes through on GET /search. This could also be filed as a bad schema-change rollout: the migration tooling ran DDL without a transaction and left the schema broken.

verdict.recommendedAction: Restore the schema right away. Either rename products.currency_code_old back to currency_code, or finish migration 0035 in a quiet window. Then check that search-api queries on products succeed. Pause any automatic re-runs of the migration until then. Afterwards, change the migration tooling so each multi-step DDL migration runs in a single transaction or has a compensating rollback step, and set lock_timeout and retry handling deliberately.
